_comment: The Proving Ground again, and this time sourced from somebody else.
It exists so the publish gate can be exercised on a whole bundle rather than
on a record built in a test. ADR 0015 forbids shipping data this project did
not source; ADR 0016 makes that enforceable by refusing to publish a version
whose facts are not first-hand unless the operator says so out loud. This is
the file that has to be refused.
Deliberately tiny. Every shape the format can hold is already covered by
proving-ground-1.0.json, and what is under test here is one field.
label: 1.0-borrowed
attribution: Synthetic fixture authored for Storm Almanac. Not derived from any published game data.

provenance.detail: Retyped out of somebody else's planner. Invented, like the rest of this fixture — what is real about it is the origin, which is the one thing under test.
